A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, and their text, equations, tables and figures are readable and reliably matched. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix. V3 refers to separate supplementary material, whose contents cannot be assessed here.

before.justification: V1 reports original scene-change detection experiments on PASLCD and scene-representation update experiments on PASLCD and CL-Splats, including quantitative results and ablations.

after.justification: V3 retains these original experiments, quantitative results, runtime measurements, ablations and qualitative comparisons.

M1.justification: The reference reconstruction, XFeat/PnP pose estimation, change cues, self-supervised fusion loss and selective scene-update procedure remain unchanged. Specifying SAM2-Tiny instead of SAM2 discloses the variant without establishing a model replacement.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate change detection on PASLCD and representation updates on PASLCD and CL-Splats. The same scene types and lighting scenarios remain; Table 1 still explicitly covers all 20 PASLCD instances.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 4 retain the same comparator membership in their corresponding experiments. Removing the InstantNGP citation and implementation descriptor does not remove CLNeRF, which remains a reconstruction baseline.

E3.justification: No replacement evaluation protocol is reported. Resolution, hardware, offline optimization budget and the 10k-iteration update ablation budget remain unchanged. The added scoring and timing descriptions disclose details; deleting the 7k/3k allocation does not establish a changed allocation.

E4.justification: Figure 4 retains the same speed–accuracy analysis, Tables 3 and 5 retain the same component ablations, and Figures 2, 5 and 6 retain the same qualitative comparisons.

E5.justification: Both versions report averages across scenes or instances without repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, statistical error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 and the plotted and illustrated results are unchanged, including online mIoU 0.486, F1 0.638 and 11.2 FPS. However, deleting the Section 3 Contributions paragraph removes the unique numerical assertion that pose estimation is approximately two orders of magnitude faster than MV3DCD's SfM-based approach.

T1.justification: Section 3.2 adds a brief complexity argument claiming O(1) pose estimation because inference uses a fixed-size reference set. Equations 1–3 and the existing loss reasoning remain unchanged; no formal proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same central claims: real-time, label-free, pose-agnostic multi-view detection, superior online/offline performance, and efficient change-guided scene updates. Calling the innovations algorithmic and system-level does not redefine those contributions.

C2.justification: V3 explicitly limits online operation to scenes static within each revisit and clarifies that future observations are unavailable. Section 3.2 adds a reference-anchoring explanation for avoiding drift accumulation. XFeat limitations are only referred to in unavailable supplementary material.

D1.justification: V3 changes the code statement from a future release to reported availability at a revised project link, specifies SAM2-Tiny, and adds scoring and wall-clock timing descriptions. Conversely, it removes the 7k selective-reconstruction/3k global-optimization allocation and CLNeRF's InstantNGP descriptor. These are documentation changes; code availability was not externally verified.

R1.justification: V3 adds a focused distinction from Furukawa et al.'s self-supervised alignment objective and a paragraph citing six robotics mapping/tracking works. It also adds explicit MV3DCD attribution for the change parameter and removes the InstantNGP reference, without substantially replacing the existing research positioning.

P1.justification: V3 rewrites the online-setting explanation, expands selected related-work passages, removes the Section 3 Contributions paragraph and makes local terminology edits. The overall section organization and most prose remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1's caption is shortened, and text, spacing and reference pagination reflow. All six figures and five tables remain, preserving their substantive visual content and table structures.

improvement.justification: V3 modestly improves scope clarity, prior-work positioning and implementation specificity through the static-revisit qualification, the self-supervised alignment comparison and SAM2-Tiny disclosure. These gains are partly offset by removing the 7k/3k update schedule and adding an FPS sentence that describes time per frame rather than frames per second. The empirical evidence remains unchanged, so the overall improvement is limited.
